brand.tagline: Partner verification for Japanese SMEs entering India
brand.position: Shinrai maps Indian companies, the people behind them and the ground they stand on, so Japanese SMEs can trust a partner before they sign.
landing.pillars: Three evidence layers and a next step
pillar.paper.body: Registry, GST, courts, insolvency and news. Proves the company is real and compliant, and who is behind it.
pillar.ground.body: Satellite imagery and building history at the claimed site. Proves the factory exists, how big it is and since when.
pillar.money.body: GST returns shared with the partner's consent. Compares real turnover with claimed turnover.
pillar.action.body: A 稟議書 for internal approval, and an on-site audit when the digital check is not enough.

partners.title: Partner candidates
partners.name: Company name
partners.doc_hint: PDF or text. Shinrai checks every claim in it against official records.
partners.empty: Add the first Indian company you are considering. A name is enough; a CIN or GSTIN makes the match exact.
report.ringi: 稟議書を作成 / Create Ringi-sho
report.disclaimer: Shinrai is a due-diligence aid, not a legal opinion. Every finding links to the public record it came from; absence of a record is not proof of good standing.
ground.tagline: Genchi genbutsu from space: go and see the actual place, digitally.
ground.limits: Building data ~4 m effective resolution, 2016–2023; Sentinel-2 10 m; satellites show structures, not operations.
